description: Default capabilities for Resonance Scribe. Explicit allow-* per plugin: `<plugin>:default` alone grants nothing an operation needs (ANDROID-BUILD-LAWS.md section 1). The base is NOT reached from the window — it is Rust's, behind the commands — so no sql:* permission exists here at all. fs and dialog stand for the bind room (S3), which writes a manuscript folder to a path the dialog itself grants.
